name: @costops/costops-agents
description: Unified Cloud Function for all CostOps agents

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:audit && node --test dist/handler.test.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy costops-agents --gen2 --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --region us-central1 --project agentics-dev --entry-point handler --memory 512MB --timeout 120s --no-allow-unauthenticated --source=.
